seoDescription: Sunset Garden blouse with floral Aari work, gold beads and pearl accents. Pair with orange, gold or silk sarees. Listed at ₹8,499; timing by enquiry.
seoCopy: Sunset Garden features a burnt-orange base with multicolour floral and paisley-inspired motifs, gold-toned beadwork, pearl-style accents and embellished puff sleeves. The listed technique combines Aari-style floral embroidery, beadwork and pearl-style embellishment; the exact materials can be confirmed for the chosen version during your enquiry. The warm palette can work with orange, rust, gold, cream or complementary silk sarees, while a saree border that repeats one of the accent colours can help the outfit feel intentional. Compare the design with your actual saree and jewellery, especially where the blouse sleeve detail meets the border. The listed starting price is ₹8,499 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment; the garment, courier and changes beyond the displayed materials are separate. Share the event date, garment readiness and desired coverage in your enquiry, and Khadeeja Designs will confirm whether the requested work fits the current studio schedule before accepting the order. The design suits both daytime ceremonies and evening celebrations.
summary: A burnt-orange blouse with multicolour floral embroidery, pearl accents and embellished puff sleeves.
description: The front features a warm orange base decorated with colourful floral and paisley-inspired motifs, pearl-like accents, gold-toned beadwork and detailed puff sleeves finished with decorative edging. Hand-embroidered to order in Trichy, the warm palette suits haldi mornings, mehendi evenings and festive celebrations.

faqs.q: What occasion is Sunset Garden best for?
faqs.a: Haldi, mehendi and daytime festive functions. The warm orange base with multicolour florals looks bright in daylight photographs.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Sunset Garden?
faqs.a: Burnt orange, rust, warm gold and cream silk let the florals stand out. Deep green or maroon gives a striking contrast. Pick a border that repeats one of the accent colours.

faqs.q: Why is Sunset Garden priced higher than other designs?
faqs.a: It has the most hand work of our designer pieces: multicolour floral and paisley motifs, pearl-style accents, gold beadwork and detailed puff sleeve edging. More stitching and more embellishment mean more hours at the frame.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Sunset Garden?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Sunset Garden?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
